author: shnade
quote: Boring, sterile story with zero charisma from the main cast. Graphics are okay, I guess, but nothing crazy-definitely not worth suffering through a choppy 30 FPS. 15 hours in and I haven't laughed once. It’s honestly wild how dull they managed to make this. GTA used to have actual bite, great satire, and iconic characters with real flaws. All that soul is just gone now. GTA is supposed to be fun, and this just isn't.
